articles.title: Blinkit crosses 1,000 dark store milestone — eyes 2,000 by end of FY27
articles.summary: Blinkit, the Zomato-owned quick commerce platform, crossed the 1,000 dark store mark this week, cementing its position as the category leader. The company plans to double the count to 2,000 by FY27-end, targeting Tier 2 expansions in Jaipur, Surat, and Lucknow.

articles.title: Swiggy Instamart's EBITDA burns widen as store count stagnates in Q4 FY26
articles.summary: Swiggy Instamart's per-order losses widened to ₹76 in Q4 FY26 even as rival Blinkit turned EBITDA-positive at the dark store level. The platform added fewer than 15 new dark stores in the quarter, fuelling investor concerns about its quick commerce competitiveness.

articles.title: Zepto raises $350M Series G at $7B valuation; targets 700 stores by December
articles.summary: Zepto has closed a $350 million Series G round at a $7 billion post-money valuation, with participation from Nexus and existing investors. The funds will be deployed toward rapid dark store expansion and logistics infrastructure across 25 cities.

articles.title: HUL's QCom channel now 9% of total ecommerce GMV — quick commerce outpaces modern trade
articles.summary: Hindustan Unilever's quick commerce contribution has risen sharply, with Blinkit and Zepto now accounting for 9% of its total ecommerce GMV. The company flagged that premium SKUs — particularly in Beauty & Wellbeing — are growing 3x faster on quick commerce vs modern trade.

articles.title: Meesho quietly crosses 200M registered users; doubles down on value grocery
articles.summary: Meesho has hit 200 million registered users, driven by aggressive expansion into grocery and staples in Tier 3+ cities. The platform is piloting a 'Meesho Fresh' vertical targeting monthly grocery baskets in markets underserved by quick commerce players.

articles.title: Retail media ad spend in India to cross ₹5,000 crore in FY27 — Flipkart and Blinkit lead
articles.summary: India's retail media market is projected to cross ₹5,000 crore in FY27, up 60% YoY. Flipkart Commerce Media and Blinkit Ads are the dominant platforms; brands are shifting 15-20% of digital budgets into in-platform placements as attribution improves.

articles.title: BigBasket slips to fourth in quick commerce rankings as BB Now expansion stalls
articles.summary: BigBasket's BB Now has dropped to fourth in the quick commerce rankings by GMV, behind Blinkit, Zepto, and Swiggy Instamart. Tata Digital is reportedly reassessing the dark store model as part of a broader FY27 profitability drive.

articles.title: D2C brands see 40% repeat rate uplift via Blinkit — quick commerce becomes retention channel
articles.summary: Several D2C brands report that quick commerce is outperforming their own DTC websites on repeat rate metrics. Mamaearth, mCaffeine, and Plum cite Blinkit as their highest-retention channel — driven by convenience-led replenishment behaviour.
